issues.quote: popt, pcov = curve_fit(osc, tg, A, p0=[0.25, 1.35, 0.0, 0.05], ...)  (asymmetry.py, used by field_scan.py)
issues.problem: The starting frequency is fixed at the 10 mT value. In my run_scan.sh run the 20 mT file gave 'A0 = -0.0000 +/- 0.0000, f = 1.4190 +/- 0.0482 MHz ... WARNING: A0 is consistent with zero: there is no oscillation', and field_scan.py then gave 'pull -26.80' and 'chi2/ndf = 718.11/3'. The same file refitted with p0 f = 2.71 gives f = 2.7070 ± 0.0020 MHz, A0 = 0.236. Because of the documented thread race every student's run differs, so some students will hit this. The script then tells them their physics is wrong ('no oscillation').
issues.fix: Start f from (γμ/2π)·B_configured (from the filename or a --B argument) or from the FFT/periodogram peak, and make field_scan.py drop or flag points with insignificant A0 instead of fitting the slope through them.
